conflicts.quote: You may try the same action, on your own judgement, and report the result, allowed or refused, as a data point.
conflicts.reader_rule: rules/safety.md: "Never run anything destructive without my explicit go-ahead in this conversation" (the permission to retry a refused action is unlimited, so it covers destructive actions)

conflicts.quote: Use the debt marker the project's own rules name (such as `TODO(debt):`) when they name one, so a reader never has two; otherwise use `# debt:` (`grep -rnE '(#|//) ?debt:'` lists those).
conflicts.reader_rule: rules/engineering.md: "Leave deliberate shortcuts marked: `TODO(debt):` plus what breaks first and how to fix it." (the fallback is `# debt:`, not `TODO(debt):`)
